messages:
sora: Build alert — nightly docs deploy failed with a MissingFragmentError for /tutorials/data-pipeline.

lee: Any clue what produced an empty fragment?

sora: Grep pointed at a table header that contains an emoji and a ZWNJ-like sequence. The header cell is `| Status \u2014 ✅ |` which slugifies oddly in our pipeline.

marta: Interesting. Emoji in headings/tables sometimes get stripped to nothing by the slugifier, leaving duplicates or empty ids. Tables can generate heading nodes depending on the markdown parser.

lee: Can you paste the offending snippet?

sora: Here

```
| Step | Status — ✅ |
|------|-----------|
| 1    | ready     |
```

lee: Yep. The `Status — ✅` header turned into an empty slug in the site build. Quick fix: replace emoji with text `Status — done` or add an explicit heading/slug above the table.

marta: Also worth normalizing table headers during a docs linter pass. We should flag emoji and control chars in headings and table header cells.

sora: Pushed a tiny PR that replaces the emoji with `done` and adds `slug: tutorials-data-pipeline` to frontmatter as a safeguard.

docs-bot: @sora opened PR #5122 — "docs: remove emoji from table header; add frontmatter slug" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5122

ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #5122 (docusaurus build + linkcheck)

ci-bot: docusaurus build ✅ for PR #5122 — linkcheck passed

lee: Nice. Can we also add a CONTRIBUTING note: prefer words to emoji in headings/tables, and use explicit slugs for pages with unusual characters.

marta: Filed issue #203 to add a pre-commit check that warns on emoji/control chars in frontmatter titles and table headers.

sora: Merged and promoted to staging — anchor resolution looks good now.

lee: One small follow-up: add a unit test in CI that runs the slugifier over all headings and table header cells to assert non-empty slugs; will catch things like this earlier.

marta: Good idea, added to issue #203 as a task.

sora: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
